description: This Java class defines the 'FineractPlatformTenantConnection' which holds configuration details for tenant database connections in the Fineract platform. It includes tenant-specific fields, connection parameters, and utility methods for URL formation and protocol extraction.

classes.name: FineractPlatformTenantConnection
classes.description: Represents the database connection configuration details for a tenant in the Fineract platform, including connection strings, credentials, and connection pool settings.

methods.name: toJdbcUrl
methods.description: Constructs a JDBC URL string from protocol, host, port, database name, and optional parameters.

methods.name: toProtocol
methods.description: Extracts the protocol (e.g., 'jdbc:mysql') from a given DataSource by inspecting the connection metadata.
